statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let _J := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let Jr := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, E ((k:ℝ)*β); ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ), 0<n → 0≤h → (let f := fun t : ℝ => V n (t/n)/(n:ℂ); (∀ t : ℝ, ‖f t - E (t/2)*(Real.sinc (Real.pi*t):ℂ)‖ ≤ 2*Real.pi*|t|/(n:ℝ)) ∧ |((_J (h/n) (fun β => (V n β)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*β))).re/(n:ℝ)) - Jr h (fun t => Real.sinc (Real.pi*t)^2)| ≤ 4*Real.pi*h^2/(n:ℝ) ∧ |Jr (h/n) (fun β => ‖V n β‖^2)/(n:ℝ) - Jr h (fun t => Real.sinc (Real.pi*t)^2)| ≤ 4*Real.pi*h^2/(n:ℝ))

brief.zh: 将 [0,1] 分成 n 个子区间，逐段用相位弦长控制右端点 Riemann 和。用同一误差处理乘 e(−nβ) 的平方以及模型能量。
brief.en: Split [0,1] into n cells and bound the error of each right-endpoint term by the phase chord length. Apply the same estimate to the square with e(−nβ) and to the model energy.
